criterion_fired: CRITERION 2 (Carry-forward Inconsistency) and CRITERION 3 (Evidence Quality on Competition)
suggested_change: CRITERION 2: Allow score regressions if accompanied by explicit reasoning (e.g., 'Prior 6/10 assumed X; new data reveals X was unsupported'). Require carry-forward *reasoning*, not carry-forward *scores*. CRITERION 3: Separate 'competitor mapping' (is it in standard set?) from 'buyer frame inference' (what use case does the evidence support?). Non-standard competitor identification alone does not warrant ICP misalignment claim without direct contradictory evidence from the call.
